examTags: 词汇·序数词词义与拼写
语言运用·日期、楼层与顺序表达
grammar: num. 第一。序数词表示次序，可作限定词（the first day、my first day），也可单独表示名次。缩写为 1st；数字以 11、12、13 结尾时用 th，其余末位 1、2、3 分别用 st、nd、rd，其他用 th。
collocations: the first day; first place; first prize; first of all
commonMistake: first 是不规则拼写，不说 oneth；日期缩写为 1st。注意 11th 是例外，不能只看末位 1 写成 11st。

example.english: This is the first book I borrowed from the library.
example.chinese: 这是我从图书馆借的第一本书。

application.prompt: A calendar marks day number 1 in May. Write the ordinal word: the ___ day of May.

examTags: 词汇·序数词词义与拼写
语言运用·日期、楼层与顺序表达
grammar: num. 第二。序数词可放在名词前表示顺序，也可单独表示名次；日期写作 2nd。缩写中末位 2 通常用 nd，但 12th 属于 11、12、13 的特殊情况。
collocations: the second day; second place; the second floor; a second chance
commonMistake: second 是不规则拼写；2nd 写作 nd，但 12 的缩写是 12th，不是 12nd。

example.english: Our classroom is on the second floor.
example.chinese: 我们的教室在二楼。

application.prompt: A runner finishes after one other runner. Write the ordinal word for this position: ___ place.

examTags: 词汇·序数词词义与拼写
语言运用·日期、楼层与顺序表达
grammar: num. 第三。序数词常放在限定词后、名词前，如 the third question；也可单独表示名次。数字缩写为 3rd；13th 是特殊形式。
collocations: the third day; third place; the third question; the third of May
commonMistake: third 是不规则拼写；3rd 用 rd，但 13th 以 th 结尾，不能写成 13rd。

example.english: Leo finished third in the school race.
example.chinese: 利奥在校运会中获得第三名。

application.prompt: On a list, the position after first and second is the ___. Write the ordinal word.

examTags: 词汇·序数词词义与拼写
语言运用·日期、楼层与顺序表达
grammar: num. 第四。通常作限定词修饰名词，也可单独表示顺序；数字缩写为 4th。日期中可写 May 4th，也可写 4th May。
collocations: the fourth day; the fourth question; fourth place; the fourth of July
commonMistake: fourth 以 th 结尾，缩写是 4th，不是 4rd；不要把基数词 four 直接当作序数词。

example.english: The fourth question asks us to read a calendar.
example.chinese: 第四题要求我们看日历。

application.prompt: A building map marks a room on level 4. Write the ordinal word: the ___ floor.

examTags: 词汇·序数词词义与拼写
语言运用·日期、楼层与顺序表达
grammar: num. 第五。作定语时说 the fifth page、my fifth day；日期缩写为 5th。
collocations: the fifth day; fifth place; the fifth page; the fifth of June
commonMistake: five 变 fifth 时，ve 改为 f 再加 th；写作 fifth，不是 fiveth，日期缩写是 5th。

example.english: She is reading her fifth book this month.
example.chinese: 她这个月正在读她的第五本书。

application.prompt: This is day 5 of the school trip. Write the ordinal word: the ___ day.

examTags: 词汇·序数词词义与拼写
语言运用·日期、楼层与顺序表达
grammar: num. 第六。常作限定词，如 the sixth student；数字缩写为 6th。
collocations: the sixth day; the sixth student; sixth place; the sixth of August
commonMistake: sixth 的拼写为 six + th，不说 sixeth；日期缩写写 6th。

example.english: The sixth student on the list is Amy.
example.chinese: 名单上的第六位学生是艾米。

application.prompt: A student is number 6 on the class list. Write the ordinal word: the ___ student.

examTags: 词汇·序数词词义与拼写
语言运用·日期、楼层与顺序表达
grammar: num. 第七。可修饰名词表示顺序，如 the seventh meeting；数字缩写为 7th。
collocations: the seventh day; the seventh meeting; seventh place; the seventh of September
commonMistake: seventh 是 seven 加 th，拼写中保留 seven 的 n；不要写成 seveneth，缩写是 7th。

example.english: Our club's seventh meeting is on Friday.
example.chinese: 我们社团的第七次活动在星期五。

application.prompt: The schedule labels this as meeting number 7. Write the ordinal word: the ___ meeting.

examTags: 词汇·序数词词义与拼写
语言运用·日期、楼层与顺序表达
grammar: num. 第八。用作限定词时放在名词前，如 the eighth page；数字缩写为 8th。
collocations: the eighth day; the eighth page; eighth place; the eighth of October
commonMistake: eighth 的正确拼写只有一个 t，不是 eightth；缩写为 8th。

example.english: The eighth page has a picture of a map.
example.chinese: 第八页上有一幅地图。

application.prompt: A book's page number is 8. Write the ordinal word: the ___ page.

examTags: 词汇·序数词词义与拼写
语言运用·日期、楼层与顺序表达
grammar: num. 第九。可修饰名词，如 the ninth question；日期缩写为 9th。
collocations: the ninth day; the ninth question; ninth place; the ninth of November
commonMistake: nine 变 ninth 时去掉词尾 e 再加 th；写作 ninth，不是 nineth，缩写为 9th。

example.english: Our team finished ninth in the quiz competition.
example.chinese: 我们队在知识竞赛中获得第九名。

application.prompt: A quiz result shows position number 9. Write the ordinal word: ___ place.

examTags: 词汇·序数词词义与拼写
语言运用·日期、楼层与顺序表达
grammar: num. 第十。作限定词时放在名词前，如 the tenth stop；数字缩写为 10th。
collocations: the tenth day; the tenth stop; tenth place; the tenth of December
commonMistake: ten 的序数词为 tenth，缩写 10th；末位数字是 0 时用 th。

example.english: The tenth stop is near the library.
example.chinese: 第十站在图书馆附近。

application.prompt: A bus route has ten stops. Write the ordinal word for stop number 10: the ___ stop.

examTags: 词汇·序数词词义与拼写
语言运用·日期、楼层与顺序表达
grammar: num. 第十一。常修饰名词，如 the eleventh day；数字缩写为 11th。11、12、13 的末两位是特殊情况，均用 th。
collocations: the eleventh day; the eleventh room; eleventh place; the eleventh of April
commonMistake: 虽然 11 的末位是 1，日期缩写仍是 11th，不是 11st；eleventh 按词形记忆。

example.english: The eleventh day of our trip is our last day in Beijing.
example.chinese: 旅行的第十一天是我们在北京的最后一天。

application.prompt: Write the ordinal abbreviation for day 11 in a date: April ___.

examTags: 词汇·序数词词义与拼写
语言运用·日期、楼层与顺序表达
grammar: num. 第十二。可说 the twelfth month；日期缩写为 12th。12 与 11、13 一样，数字末两位为特殊形式，缩写用 th。
collocations: the twelfth month; the twelfth day; the twelfth question; the twelfth of May
commonMistake: twelve 变 twelfth 时 ve 改为 f；12 的日期缩写是 12th，不是 12nd。

example.english: December is the twelfth month of the year.
example.chinese: 十二月是一年中的第十二个月。

application.prompt: Write the ordinal abbreviation for day 12 in a date: June ___.

examTags: 词汇·序数词词义与拼写
语言运用·日期、楼层与顺序表达
grammar: num. 第十三。可作限定词修饰名词，如 the thirteenth question；日期缩写为 13th，13 与 11、12 一样用 th。
collocations: the thirteenth day; the thirteenth question; thirteenth place; the thirteenth of June
commonMistake: thirteen 加 th 写作 thirteenth；13 的缩写是 13th，不能按末位 3 写成 13rd。

example.english: The thirteenth question is at the bottom of the page.
example.chinese: 第十三题在这一页的底部。

application.prompt: Write the ordinal abbreviation for day 13 in a date: July ___.

examTags: 词汇·序数词词义与拼写
语言运用·日期、楼层与顺序表达
grammar: num. 第十四。常放在名词前，如 the fourteenth day；日期缩写为 14th。
collocations: the fourteenth day; the fourteenth page; fourteenth place; the fourteenth of May
commonMistake: fourteenth 由 fourteen 加 th 构成；14 的末位是 4，因此缩写为 14th。

example.english: They will arrive on the fourteenth of May.
example.chinese: 他们将在五月十四日到达。

application.prompt: Write the ordinal abbreviation for day 14 in a date: May ___.

examTags: 词汇·序数词词义与拼写
语言运用·日期、楼层与顺序表达
grammar: num. 第十五。可修饰名词，如 the fifteenth page；数字缩写为 15th。
collocations: the fifteenth day; the fifteenth page; fifteenth place; the fifteenth of July
commonMistake: fifteen 的序数词是 fifteenth，不是 fiveteenth；15 的缩写为 15th。

example.english: This is the fifteenth page of the story.
example.chinese: 这是这个故事的第十五页。

application.prompt: The schedule marks day 15 of the trip. Write the ordinal word: the ___ day.

examTags: 词汇·序数词词义与拼写
语言运用·日期、楼层与顺序表达
grammar: num. 第十六。作限定词时放在名词前，如 the sixteenth student；日期缩写为 16th。
collocations: the sixteenth day; the sixteenth student; sixteenth place; the sixteenth of August
commonMistake: sixteen 加 th 写作 sixteenth；16 末位是 6，缩写用 th，写作 16th。

example.english: The sixteenth player is waiting by the door.
example.chinese: 第十六位队员正在门边等候。

application.prompt: A team list shows player number 16. Write the ordinal word: the ___ player.

examTags: 词汇·序数词词义与拼写
语言运用·日期、楼层与顺序表达
grammar: num. 第十七。序数词作限定词时放在名词前，如 the seventeenth meeting；数字缩写为 17th。
collocations: the seventeenth day; the seventeenth meeting; seventeenth place; the seventeenth of September
commonMistake: seventeen 加 th 写作 seventeenth；17 的末位是 7，缩写用 th，写作 17th。

example.english: Her seventeenth birthday is in July.
example.chinese: 她的十七岁生日在七月。

application.prompt: A diary entry is dated day 17 of September. Write the ordinal word: the ___ day.

examTags: 词汇·序数词词义与拼写
语言运用·日期、楼层与顺序表达
grammar: num. 第十八。可修饰名词，如 the eighteenth guest；数字缩写为 18th。
collocations: the eighteenth day; the eighteenth guest; eighteenth place; the eighteenth of October
commonMistake: eighteen 加 th 写作 eighteenth；不要把 eighth 和 eighteenth 混淆，18 的缩写是 18th。

example.english: The eighteenth guest arrived before dinner.
example.chinese: 第十八位客人在晚饭前到了。

application.prompt: A guest list has 18 names. Write the ordinal word for guest number 18: the ___ guest.

examTags: 词汇·序数词词义与拼写
语言运用·日期、楼层与顺序表达
grammar: num. 第十九。常修饰名词，如 the nineteenth chapter；日期缩写为 19th。
collocations: the nineteenth day; the nineteenth chapter; nineteenth place; the nineteenth of November
commonMistake: nineteen 加 th 写作 nineteenth；19 的末位是 9，缩写为 19th。

example.english: The nineteenth chapter ends with a surprise.
example.chinese: 第十九章以一个惊喜结尾。

application.prompt: In a 20-chapter book, chapter 19 is the ___. Write the ordinal word.

examTags: 词汇·序数词词义与拼写
语言运用·日期、楼层与顺序表达
grammar: num. 第二十。可修饰名词，如 the twentieth meeting；日期缩写为 20th。
collocations: the twentieth day; the twentieth meeting; twentieth place; the twentieth of December
commonMistake: twenty 变 twentieth 时，y 改为 i 再加 eth；写作 twentieth，不是 twentyth，缩写为 20th。

example.english: Our twentieth meeting will be on Monday.
example.chinese: 我们的第二十次会议将在星期一举行。

application.prompt: A club has held 19 meetings; the next is meeting 20. Write the ordinal word: the ___ meeting.

examTags: 词汇·序数词词义与拼写
语言运用·日期、楼层与顺序表达
grammar: num. 第三十。序数词可作定语，如 the thirtieth anniversary；日期缩写为 30th。
collocations: the thirtieth day; the thirtieth anniversary; thirtieth place; the thirtieth of March
commonMistake: thirty 变 thirtieth 时，y 改为 i 再加 eth；写作 thirtieth，不是 thirtyth，缩写 30th。

example.english: The school will celebrate its thirtieth anniversary this year.
example.chinese: 学校今年将庆祝建校三十周年。

application.prompt: A school opened 30 years ago. This year is its ___ anniversary. Write the ordinal word.

examTags: 词汇·序数词词义与拼写
语言运用·日期、楼层与顺序表达
grammar: num. 第四十。常修饰名词，如 the fortieth page；数字缩写为 40th。
collocations: the fortieth day; the fortieth page; the fortieth visitor; fortieth place
commonMistake: forty 的拼写没有 u；变序数词时 y 改为 i，再加 eth：fortieth，缩写 40th。

example.english: She finished fortieth in the city race.
example.chinese: 她在市级比赛中获得第四十名。

application.prompt: A book has 40 pages. Page 40 is the ___. Write the ordinal word.

examTags: 词汇·序数词词义与拼写
语言运用·日期、楼层与顺序表达
grammar: num. 第五十。序数词常修饰名词，如 the fiftieth birthday；数字缩写为 50th。
collocations: the fiftieth day; the fiftieth birthday; the fiftieth member; fiftieth place
commonMistake: fifty 变 fiftieth 时，y 改为 i 再加 eth；不是 fiftyeth，缩写为 50th。

example.english: The club welcomed its fiftieth member today.
example.chinese: 俱乐部今天迎来了它的第五十位成员。

application.prompt: A club already has 49 members. The next person is its ___ member. Write the ordinal word.

examTags: 词汇·序数词词义与拼写
语言运用·日期、楼层与顺序表达
grammar: num. 第六十。可修饰名词，如 the sixtieth birthday；日期缩写为 60th。
collocations: the sixtieth day; the sixtieth birthday; the sixtieth page; sixtieth place
commonMistake: sixty 变 sixtieth 时，y 改为 i 再加 eth；写作 sixtieth，数字缩写为 60th。

example.english: His sixtieth birthday is next month.
example.chinese: 他的六十岁生日在下个月。

application.prompt: A book's page number is 60. Write the ordinal word: the ___ page.

examTags: 词汇·序数词词义与拼写
语言运用·日期、楼层与顺序表达
grammar: num. 第七十。可修饰名词，如 the seventieth anniversary；数字缩写为 70th。
collocations: the seventieth day; the seventieth anniversary; the seventieth visitor; seventieth place
commonMistake: seventy 变 seventieth 时，y 改为 i 再加 eth；缩写是 70th，不是 70st。

example.english: The library is holding a celebration for its seventieth anniversary.
example.chinese: 图书馆正在举办活动庆祝建馆七十周年。

application.prompt: An organization has existed for 70 years. It is celebrating its ___ anniversary. Write the ordinal word.

examTags: 词汇·序数词词义与拼写
语言运用·日期、楼层与顺序表达
grammar: num. 第八十。常用作限定词，如 the eightieth visitor；数字缩写为 80th。
collocations: the eightieth day; the eightieth visitor; the eightieth birthday; eightieth place
commonMistake: eighty 变 eightieth 时，y 改为 i 再加 eth；写作 eightieth，缩写 80th。

example.english: The eightieth visitor received a bookmark.
example.chinese: 第八十位访客收到了一枚书签。

application.prompt: A museum counts visitors in order. The visitor numbered 80 is the ___. Write the ordinal word.

examTags: 词汇·序数词词义与拼写
语言运用·日期、楼层与顺序表达
grammar: num. 第九十。可修饰名词，如 the ninetieth runner；日期缩写为 90th。
collocations: the ninetieth day; the ninetieth runner; the ninetieth page; ninetieth place
commonMistake: ninety 变 ninetieth 时，y 改为 i 再加 eth；写作 ninetieth，缩写为 90th。

example.english: The ninetieth runner crossed the finish line.
example.chinese: 第九十位跑步者冲过了终点线。

application.prompt: A race result lists a runner in position 90. Write the ordinal word: ___ place.

examTags: 词汇·序数词词义与拼写
语言运用·大数顺序表达
grammar: num. 第一百。表示顺序位置，如 the hundredth visitor；数字缩写为 100th。
collocations: the hundredth day; the hundredth visitor; the hundredth page; hundredth place
commonMistake: 表示第 100 个位置用 hundredth（100th）；one hundred 表示数量“一百”，不是“第一百”。

example.english: The hundredth visitor received a small gift.
example.chinese: 第一百位访客收到了一份小礼物。

application.prompt: A visitor is number 100 in the line. Write the ordinal word: the ___ visitor.

examTags: 词汇·序数词词义与拼写
语言运用·大数顺序表达
grammar: num. 第一千。表示排在 1,000 位的次序，如 the thousandth customer；数字缩写为 1,000th。
collocations: the thousandth customer; the thousandth visitor; the thousandth day; thousandth place
commonMistake: 表示第 1,000 个位置用 thousandth（1,000th）；one thousand 表示数量“一千”。

example.english: The museum welcomed its thousandth visitor this morning.
example.chinese: 博物馆今天上午迎来了第一千位访客。

application.prompt: A shop welcomes customer number 1,000. Write the ordinal word: the ___ customer.

examTags: 词汇·序数词词义与拼写
语言运用·大数顺序表达
grammar: num. 第一百万。表示排在 1,000,000 位的次序，如 the millionth visitor；数字缩写为 1,000,000th。
collocations: the millionth visitor; the millionth copy; the millionth customer; millionth place
commonMistake: 表示第 1,000,000 个位置用 millionth；one million 表示数量“一百万”，不表示顺序。

example.english: The website recorded its millionth visit this year.
example.chinese: 这个网站今年记录了第一百万次访问。

application.prompt: A website records visit number 1,000,000. Write the ordinal word: the ___ visit.
